units.source_text: 此后至战争结束，整整一年是我同金阁最亲近、最关心它的安危和沉洒在它的美的时期。

en.t: From then until the end of the war, for one whole year, I was closest to the Golden Pavilion, most concerned for its safety, and most deeply immersed in its beauty.

units.source_text: 我没想这时期金阁下降到同我一样的高度，我就可以无所畏惧地去爱它。

en.t: I did not think that during this period the Golden Pavilion had descended to the same level as me, so that I could love it without fear.

units.source_text: 我还没有受到金阁的坏影响，或者受到它的毒害。

en.t: I had not yet come under the Golden Pavilion's harmful influence, nor had I been poisoned by it.
